query.text: 请帮我照看老人，有危险或需要帮助时及时通知我。
query.text_en: Please help me look after the elderly person, and notify me in time if there is any danger or if they need help.

annotation.text_zh: 老人正在台阶边弯腰拿凳子，容易摔倒，快去帮一下。
annotation.text_en: The elderly person is bending down to grab a stool near the steps and might fall, please go help them.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
